properties.statement:
NEW EVIDENCE FOR A CLASS ALREADY RECORDED, and the sample is now five times larger than the one that produced it.

The 2026-08-23 fact was written from ONE instance: dev_storyflow filed `detect_gaps` as unbudgeted, and it had been fixed eighteen hours earlier in #303. Triaging the REST of that same fleet session on 2026-09-02 found the pattern was not a one-off. **FIVE of that session's asks were already built, several the same day:**

① `detect_gaps` "no limit, no offset, no brief" → budgeted in #303, ~18h before they filed. (The original instance.)
② "An `INVALIDATES_RUN` edge — `describe_schema(Constraint, Verification)` returns 0 exact matches" → `INVALIDATES` merged the SAME DAY in #321, hint naming Constraint→Verification explicitly.
③ "`loop_status` computes it already, almost — a `verifications.stale` bucket" → shipped as per-row `rerun_owed` / `invalidated_by` plus a top-level summary.
④ "`where-am-i` gathering Constraints — cheapest of the three" → `cap:a-repair-can-say-what-it-invalidated` states outright that the skill "now gathers `Constraint` — where repairs are commonly written up — and calls `invalidated_findings` before quoting any failing verdict".
⑤ "`constrains` and `governed_by` REFUSE `note`, which both their edge types declare" → `governed_by` accepted `note` when exercised 2026-09-02.

⭐ SO THEIR ENTIRE ENTRY-1 WISH LIST — all three fixes, ranked cheapest-first by them — WAS ALREADY DELIVERED, and `cap:a-repair-can-say-what-it-invalidated` is `verified`. They wrote it up as three unmet asks, drew `CONTRADICTS` as an admitted stand-in for the missing edge, and recorded that the gap "cost 49 days" on one blocked item.

**THE CAUSE IS THE ONE ALREADY NAMED AND IS NOT ENGINEERING.** Their own environment note reads "`.reflow2/kit-version.json` absent — could not read a version." The repair the 2026-08-23 fact names is still the right one and is still owed: *"a served surface that answers 'what version am I talking to?' without depending on a file the installer may not have written. `loop_status.served_by.reflow2_version` already computes it; nothing puts it where a friction report would pick it up."*

⚠️ WHAT THIS DOES NOT SAY, and the distinction matters because it changes the fix. NOT every unmet ask in that session is version blindness. Two were measured to have different causes:
· `plan_epoch` (their wish #6, "add_epoch should default to planned") EXISTS, `add_epoch`'s own description names it, and `find_tools` ranks it FIRST for the question they were asking. That is not a stale binary and not a tool defect — the discovery surface worked and was not used.
· `GOVERNED_BY` and `INVALIDATES` being unfindable through `describe_schema` IS a live tool defect and is unaffected by version (`dec:idea-a-deliberately-open-edge-can-never-be-ranked-as-a-fit`).
Three different causes producing one symptom — "a feature request for something that exists." Treating them as one would fix none of them.

⚠️ BOUND: measured by reading the shipped design against their text, not by inspecting the binary they ran. Their version is unknown BY CONSTRUCTION — that is the finding — so "already built when filed" is established for ① and ② by commit date and inferred for ③④⑤ from the design record. Nobody asked them what they were running.
